entries.buyerSummary: ABS helps keep the vehicle steerable during hard braking by preventing the wheels from locking.
entries.howItWorks: Wheel-speed sensors detect an approaching lock-up and the system repeatedly adjusts brake pressure so the tyres can keep rotating and responding to steering input.
entries.whenItMattersSummary: It matters most during emergency stops and when the road is wet or slippery.
whenItMatters: braking while steering around an obstacle
entries.limitationsSummary: ABS cannot create extra tyre grip; braking distance still depends on speed, tyres and the road surface.
entries.buyerAdvice: Treat ABS as a core safety feature, not as a premium convenience add-on.

sourceRefs.title: NHTSA Light Vehicle ABS Research Program
